what: Measured probes for every pending literature-synthesis idea (2026-10-22 persistent-loop directive). Accuracy probes were run where the idea was cheap and cache-compatible; cost/feasibility probes are labelled as such and do not claim an accuracy result.

probes.test: 20 RefCOCO val expressions, cached SAM proposals, open_clip ViT-B/32 patch-token pooling under each proposal, full-sentence text, argmax cosine; compare block 6 vs final block 11
probes.result: mid-layer 4.32 mIoU vs final 0.08 mIoU under the naive selector (+4.25 mIoU); mid-layer features carry more usable region signal, but the absolute level is far below the shipped selector
probes.decision: adopted as a scoped component insight, not a shipped change

probes.idea: attribute prompting with an LLM over proposals
probes.test: measured component cost: LLaVA-OneVision-7B latency from complexity.json (37.7 s/query warm under contention; 0.6-1.8 s/expression historical) extrapolated to 26,488 expressions with 8 proposals/expression
probes.result: ~277 h at the measured warm latency for the full three-val family, plus one LLM call per proposal; not feasible within the shared budget
probes.decision: rejected on measured cost; no accuracy claim

probes.idea: region-consistent inference over frozen CLIP tokens
probes.test: feasibility probe: the shipped cache stores proposal scores/masks, not the token graph or reference memory; re-extracting per-image token graphs costs a fresh CLIP forward per image (complexity.json feature-path cost) and the method has no referring-expression conditioning
probes.result: requires a new feature-extraction pass and does not select among same-class proposals; not adopted in this cycle

probes.test: cost probe from the dossier: earlygrounding2026 uses a 9-12B editing DiT; MAVISEG uses a diffusion transformer; our frozen path is ~0.4B CLIP + SAM and the public rows are 57.56 mIoU (earlygrounding), below the shipped 70.57 RefCOCO val
probes.result: 10-30x parameter cost with no zero-shot SOTA gain over the shipped row; not adopted
probes.decision: rejected on measured cost and published level

probes.test: 120-expression RefChess run with FG-CLIP base + GEM (16 sims): 54.13 mIoU / 52.60 oIoU / acc@0.5 62.5; full split would take ~5.3 h/dataset; no full-split result
probes.result: sample-level only; not adopted as a full pipeline
probes.decision: rejected at full-scale (sample insufficient for a paper method number)

probes.test: feasibility probe: requires modifying the CLIP visual forward pass and re-extracting every proposal feature; the paper reports OVSS class maps, not instance selection, and our wrong-instance gap is a selection failure
probes.result: no training-free path to apply it without a full feature re-extraction; not adopted

probes.test: dossier review: SatOV is remote-sensing OVSS with fixed class vocabularies and DOTA/UDD/LoveDA/Vaihingen benchmarks; no RefCOCO-family or expression-conditioned evaluation
probes.result: domain/task mismatch; its +5.6 mIoU SatUp gain is not transferable to referring selection

probes.test: cached full-sentence vs noun-phrase box-prior comparison on 1,500 rows (wild_ideas.json): sentence 68.321 vs noun 53.843 mIoU, delta +14.478; paraphrase test changed 0/608 selections
probes.result: the full-sentence text form is already the shipped box-prior protocol; expression rewriting is adopted in that limited form
